original.statement: In the SecretStore external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema, spec.provider.fake.data[].value becomes required (items required changes from ["key"] to ["key","value"]), so SecretStores omitting it are rejected.

decision.reason: [ev-210dbd3942ad] shows that in the secretstores.external-secrets.io v1beta1 schema, the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"]. Only SecretStore objects with a fake data entry that has no value are exposed. That is exactly the proposed condition: a v1beta1 SecretStore resource where data[] is set and data[].value is unset. The same change in ClusterSecretStore ([ev-9fd85560a485]) is in a different CRD, so it belongs to its own change and should not be added here.
